content: How Enable/Disable Member Dashboard Forms per Membership Plan Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000681812 This article explains how to identify and then enable or disable member dashboard forms for each membership plan. About Member Dashboard Forms By default, three forms are displayed in the member dashboard: Identify Forms Currently Used These forms can be enabled or disabled by navigating to: Finance section Click Membership Plans Then click 'Edit' for the membership plan to be modified. Go to Member's Dashboard tab Under the Member's Dashboard tab, member dashboard forms can be enabled or disabled. Example: Disabling a Form In this example, the Additional Details and About Me forms are disabled as shown above. Go to Member Dashboard tab Identify the Section Front-End Members View This is how the member dashboard looks after the changes: For additional assistance: Email support@brilliantdirectories.com or create a ticket Inside Your Account Dashboard .
